name: halliday-sfl-analysis-skill
description: Hallidayan SFL and grammatical-metaphor identification with retained-source integrity and page/slide-verified citations.

interface.shortDescription: Hallidayan analysis with complete, page/slide-verified source tracing.
interface.longDescription: Analyze texts through field, tenor, mode, ideational, interpersonal, and textual meaning; identify grammatical metaphor with explicit congruent agnates, evidence, counter-tests, and confidence; preserve private PDF/PPTX evidence with integrity metadata; and support theoretical claims with complete source identities and verified page or slide citations.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this text with Hallidayan SFL at full depth and cite page-verified primary sources.
Compare the metafunctional choices in these two passages.
Unpack the grammatical metaphors in this academic text.
Decide whether this clause or word contains grammatical metaphor, give the congruent form and identification evidence, and cite exact source pages.
